created_for: Pre-draw immutable shadow registration. This manifest must be committed before the 2026-11-13 #115000105 draw; never revise the sealed blob after outcomes.

experiment.selection_timing: Both four-ticket portfolios and all endpoints fixed before the first prospective 2026-11-13 draw. No per-draw updates or historical reruns.

primary_comparison.name: geometry_p3b_counterfactual_vs_history_blind_random_control
primary_comparison.event: Per draw: whether at least one of four tickets receives an official Taiwan Lotto649 prize, using six main numbers plus distinct special number
primary_comparison.comparison: Paired difference in the number of 9 draws with any awarded ticket: geometry minus random
primary_comparison.null: All legal four-disjoint-ticket portfolios have equal fair IID marginal odds; paired outcomes can be dependent because both see the same draws and tickets can overlap
primary_comparison.inferential_method: Exact conditional paired sign/McNemar-style test is possible on discordant draw indicators, but n=9 is severely underpowered. Treat all results as DESCRIPTIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE and no predictive GO.
primary_comparison.early_peeking_rule: Before all 9 official outcomes: only per-draw descriptive observations and PENDING status. No new choice, no refit, no early-stopping claim.

metrics: Per-draw best main-number match count among the four tickets
Distribution of best matches across all 9 draws
Official prize tiers and monetary returns only where a verified payout source is available
secondary_exploratory.multiple_testing: Secondary outcomes are descriptive; no predictive hypothesis is declared for them.
secondary_exploratory.replay_controls: Preserve all ticket selections even if one arm starts out-performing; never post-select a new strategy.

fair_iid_context.source: Original frozen P3f prospective manifest, fair IID exact-prize coverage description
fair_iid_context.caveat: Equal marginal chance does not imply independent events between competing portfolios on a shared draw.

experiment.evaluation_policy: Preregister fixed numbers and windows now; future validated official draw ingestion and prize-tier checker are separate M2/M3 steps. No future outcome included in this seal.
experiment.immutability: NEVER edit this source file after creation. New hypotheses require a new experiment ID, artifact and commit. Outcomes must be recorded separately in append-only evaluations.

geometry_p3b_counterfactual.research_origin: Original 2026-11-11 CI P3B artifact, frozen before #115000105

history_blind_random_control.research_origin: Identical four tickets from original v0.27 P3f pre-registered public control; no re-randomization

methodological_caveats: Source P3B improvement is a mathematical within-history repair, not predictive evidence; P2A/P2B and P3B IID controls did not show an anomaly.
Only future official draws #115000105..#115000113 can be used for this prospectively registered comparison.
Nine draws provide very low statistical power: any apparent performance difference must not be interpreted as a reliable edge.
Primary endpoint is an exploratory pilot despite prespecified direction; prospective preregistration does not cure earlier research multiple-selection bias.
Both four-disjoint portfolios have identical marginal per-draw winning probability under fair independent draws.
User-paid lottery tickets and purchased M0 four bets are NOT present in this public shadow manifest.
No lottery purchase, no automated wager, and no modification of any existing seal or historical CSV/BIN file.
